title: Stochastic Optimal Control with Measurable Coefficients and Applications
abstract: arXiv:2502.02352v4 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: We consider fully non-linear stochastic optimal control problems with measurable coefficients and (local) uniformly elliptic diffusion. Using the theory of $L^p$-viscosity solutions, we show existence of an $L^p$-viscosity solution $v\in W_{\rm loc}^{2,p}$ of the Hamilton-Jacobi-Bellman (HJB) equation, which, in turn, is also a strong solution (i.e. it satisfies the HJB equation pointwise a.e.). We are then led to prove verification theorems, providing necessary and sufficient conditions for optimality. These results allow us to construct optimal feedback controls and to characterize the value function as the unique $L^p$-viscosity solution of the HJB equation. To the best of our knowledge, these are the first results for fully non-linear stochastic optimal control problems with measurable coefficients. translated_title: 可测系数的随机最优控制及其应用
translated_abstract: 我们考虑具有可测系数和（局部）一致椭圆扩散的完全非线性随机最优控制问题。利用 $L^p$-粘性解理论，我们证明了 Hamilton-Jacobi-Bellman (HJB) 方程存在一个 $L^p$-粘性解 $v\in W_{\rm loc}^{2,p}$，并且该解也是一个强解（即它在几乎处处逐点满足 HJB 方程）。在此基础上，我们证明了验证定理，给出了最优性的充要条件。这些结果使我们能够构造最优反馈控制，并将值函数刻画为 HJB 方程唯一的 $L^p$-粘性解。据我们所知，这是关于具有可测系数的完全非线性随机最优控制问题的首个结果。我们运用所发展的理论求解了经济学中出现的一个随机最优控制问题，该问题处于最优框架的背景下。
tldr: 该论文首次针对具有可测系数的完全非线性随机最优控制问题，利用 $L^p$-粘性解理论证明了 HJB 方程强解的存在性，建立最优性充要条件的验证定理，并据此构造最优反馈控制、刻画值函数的唯一性。
en_tdlr: This paper presents the first results for fully non-linear stochastic optimal control problems with measurable coefficients, proving the existence of a strong solution to the HJB equation via $L^p$-viscosity solution theory, establishing verification theorems with necessary and sufficient conditions for optimality, and constructing optimal feedback controls with a uniqueness characterization of the value function.
